name: Kraken
source: A Kraken type monster girl. This Kraken is [url=http://vndb.org/c13604]Baron Squid's[/url] most loyal ally although he doesn't seem to realize it. She will do most anything to protect him although she refuses to fight [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url], [url=http://vndb.org/c10476]Vanilla[/url], [url=http://vndb.org/c10477]Kusushi[/url], [url=http://vndb.org/c13594]Valkyrie[/url] or their allies. She just wants Baron Squid to be good.
